name: S.S. Steven R. Nagel
about: S.S. Steven R. Nagel (2026-079A), a crewed vehicle (Cygnus), launched 2026 Apr 11. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (GRP).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (2026 Apr 11), held fixed
docked to A06499; GCAT's tables give no later phase (undocking, landing)
